core: Nuclear envelope and nuclear pore complex organization
name: Mitotic nuclear envelope and pore complex breakdown and reassembly
rationale: All members concern nuclear envelope/NPC assembly, positioning or function, and unlike the transport/SUMOylation confusables the theme includes lamina depolymerization and NE disassembly and reformation.

name: Podocyte and glomerular filtration barrier development
rationale: Members cover podocyte migration and development, nephrin interactions, GBM formation and albumin handling, whereas confusables emphasize mesangial, endothelial and tubular kidney development.

name: Intestinal and renal hexose transport and disaccharide digestion
rationale: Members are sugar transporters (SGLT/GLUT defects, hexose absorption) and disaccharide digestion, distinguishing the theme from confusables centred on galactose/fructose catabolism or urate and amino acid transport.

name: FGFR1 and FGFR2 activation and downstream signaling
rationale: Members are ligand binding, splicing, mutant activation and FRS/SHC/PLCG/PI3K cascades of FGFR1 and FGFR2, while confusables are built around FGFR3 and FGFR4.

name: Cholesterol uptake via LDL receptor endocytosis and degradation
rationale: Members concern LDLR/VLDLR internalization, lysosomal receptor degradation, LDL clearance and sterol feedback on uptake and synthesis, unlike confusables focused on HDL and cholesterol efflux.

name: IgE receptor-triggered mast cell activation and degranulation
rationale: Members are FcεRI signaling (calcium, MAPK, NF-kB) and its mast cell outputs (degranulation, histamine, cytokines), distinct from mast cell differentiation, Th2 and Fc-gamma confusables.

qualifier: RAS GTPase regulation by GEFs and GAPs
name: RAS GTPase regulation and RAS-RAF-MAPK signaling
rationale: Members center on RAS activation and inactivation (SOS, GAPs, NF1, MRAS-SHOC2, RAS mutants) feeding RAF/MAPK, whereas confusables emphasize BRAF/RAF1 mutants or ERK negative feedback.

qualifier: oocyte meiotic maturation and primordial germ cells
name: Oocyte meiotic maturation and primordial germ cell development
rationale: Members cover meiotic activation, oocyte maturation and primordial germ cell migration, proliferation and death, distinct from male gonad, germline stem cell and ovarian follicle confusables.

qualifier: hair follicle, glands, nail and melanocytes
name: Ectodermal appendage, hair follicle and melanocyte development
rationale: Members are ectoderm-derived structures (hair follicle, sebaceous and mammary gland, nail, papillae) plus melanocytes, unlike confusables centred on keratinocyte differentiation and cornification or tooth development.

name: Monocyte trafficking and inhibitory control of leukocyte chemotaxis
rationale: Members regulate leukocyte migration, mostly negatively (monocyte, macrophage, T cell chemotaxis, integrin adhesion) with CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte modules, whereas confusables emphasize positive monocyte activation and chemokine clusters.

name: SRP-dependent and tail-anchored protein targeting to ER
rationale: Members are co- and post-translational ER targeting and membrane insertion plus ER retention and folding, distinct from COPII export and ERAD confusables.

core: Cell cycle arrest and quiescence control
name: p53-driven transcriptional G1 arrest and G0/G1 transitions
rationale: Members are p53 (and FOXO, p75NTR) transcriptional control of G1 arrest and G0/G1 transitions, while confusables focus on p53-driven apoptosis, p14ARF defects or retinoic acid differentiation.

name: Arterial smooth muscle contraction and vasoconstrictor tone
rationale: All members concern contraction or relaxation of arterial smooth muscle controlling blood pressure, whereas confusables are adrenergic receptor signaling, renin-angiotensin or NO-cGMP pathways.

name: Neurotrophin-3 signaling through TRKC and TRKB receptors
rationale: Members are NTF3 activation of NTRK3 and NTRK2 and their PI3K, RAS and PLCG1 arms, unlike confusables built around NGF-TRKA or BDNF/NTF4-TRKB.

qualifier: Rac-driven, with endosomal trafficking in myeloid cells
name: Rac-driven ruffling, macropinocytosis and endosomal trafficking
rationale: Members concern Rac-dependent ruffles, podosomes, macropinocytosis, early endosome sorting and macrophage fusion/DAP12, while confusables are clathrin/caveolin endocytosis or RHO GTPase cycles.

name: Cation-chloride cotransporters, potassium channels and sodium transport regulation
rationale: Members are SLC12 cotransporters, K+ channel families and regulation of Na+/K+ flux, distinct from confusables on osmotic responses, magnesium/paracellular transport and Na+/H+ exchangers.

name: Glucagon-PKA signaling and regulation of gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members are glucagon secretion and response, PKA/AMPK phosphorylation of metabolic factors and gluconeogenesis regulation, unlike confusables on glycogen, insulin secretion or insulin/adiponectin signaling.

name: Ionotropic glutamate receptor signaling at excitatory postsynapses
rationale: Members are AMPA, NMDA and kainate receptor activation, clustering and signaling driving glutamatergic transmission, whereas confusables cover receptor endosomal recycling, long-term plasticity, presynaptic modulation or CREB signaling.

qualifier: E2F transcription and pre-replicative complex licensing
name: E2F G1/S transcription and pre-replicative complex licensing
rationale: Members combine E2F-driven G1/S transcription with ORC/CDC6 pre-RC assembly, distinct from confusables on replication stress checkpoints and broad cell cycle modules.

name: Peroxisomal alpha- and beta-oxidation of fatty acids
rationale: Members are peroxisomal VLCFA/pristanoyl beta-oxidation, phytanate alpha-oxidation and PUFA processing, unlike confusables on mitochondrial short/medium-chain catabolism or VLCFA and ether lipid synthesis.

name: Di- and tricarboxylate and organic anion transport
rationale: Members are transport of succinate, alpha-ketoglutarate, pyruvate and other carboxylates by SLC13/17/25 carriers, distinct from malate-aspartate shuttle, amino acid and organic cation confusables.

name: Phosphate transport and bone, dentin and enamel mineralization
rationale: Members concern phosphate transport and response plus regulation of bone and tooth mineralization and ectopic calcification, unlike confusables centred on FGF23-Klotho, type II Na/Pi cotransporters or odontoblast differentiation.

name: Fructose, polyol and glucuronate-xylulose pentose metabolism
rationale: Members are fructose catabolism disorders, alditol/glycerol-3-phosphate and glucuronate-to-xylulose pentose metabolism, distinct from galactose Leloir and pentose phosphate shunt confusables.

name: Protein lysine acetylation and H3K4 methyltransferase complexes
rationale: Most members are lysine acetylation (HATs, N-terminal and tubulin) and KMT2/WDR5 histone methylation with TFAP2 coactivation, whereas confusables emphasize BAF/NuRD remodeling, deacetylation, chromosome condensation or DNA methylation.

core: Neural progenitor proliferation and neuronal differentiation
name: Neural progenitor proliferation and midbrain dopaminergic neuron differentiation
rationale: Members cover neuroblast/radial glia division and neuron differentiation in midbrain, cerebellum and forebrain, with dopaminergic and cerebellar granule precursor terms distinguishing it from glial-fate, patterning and axon guidance confusables.
